name: opengrip-studio
description: OpenGrip Studio Recorder: clean, labelled FMG/EMG recordings from an Arduino over Web Serial.

scripts.arduino:check: for s in arduino/*/; do for b in arduino:avr:uno arduino:avr:nano; do arduino-cli compile --fqbn $b --warnings all $s >/dev/null || exit 1; done; done && echo 'arduino: both sketches compile for Uno and Nano'
